The weight is acted on by the spring and by gravity. When the weight is below the rest position, the combined forces pull it up, and when it is above the rest position, they pull it down. The weight’s acceleration is always proportional to the negative of its displacement. This property of springs is called Hooke’s Law, and is studied further in Section 6.5. 4.
